files_changed.summary: Stage string type mirroring the 7-value pipeline_stage enum; exported Order slice as the single canonical-order declaration.
Pure Allowed(from, to Stage) bool: true only for the immediate-successor pair in Order; derives from Order, no hardcoded sequence.
Table-driven tests: all 6 valid forward transitions, plus backward/skip/self/unknown-stage rejections, plus an Order-matches-canonical-sequence check.

Dropped stale 'Not yet implemented'; noted Stage/Order/Allowed now exist, orchestration still doesn't. Kept as the sole package-doc-comment file, matching the doc.go convention used by internal/auth, internal/llm, etc.

decisions: internal/pipeline/stages/ subpackage and registry.go (map[Stage]Handler) are not created in this task — deferred to the first task that adds a real stage handler, per the open_question in analyze.json. This task's Order in stage.go is the single order source those future files must import rather than redeclare.
